issue.title: Bucket alias actions race the models panel snapshot worker
issue.description: Proposed by phase sase-1aa.2 note #2. In tests/test_models_panel_actions.py::test_alias_actions_on_bucket_are_guarded[o], a full parallel run raised OptionDoesNotExist for bucket:research, while the same node passed alone and on the clean base. The test calls highlight_row after only pilot.pause; alias rows are applied asynchronously by the provider-snapshot worker. Add wait_for_snapshot_idle before bucket highlighting and keep the action assertions. This is the same race mechanism documented for neighboring models-panel tests in sase-x1 and sase-x2, but this is a distinct node per the retired sase-ct umbrella policy.

task_type_fields.evidence: One failure in four identical parameters under full parallel load (OptionDoesNotExist bucket:research); the node passed solo on the same tree and clean base. Current isolated rerun passed all four parameters. The test lacks wait_for_snapshot_idle after mount, matching existing x1/x2 race evidence.
task_type_fields.repro_cmd: just check (full parallel lane); isolate with .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_models_panel_actions.py::test_alias_actions_on_bucket_are_guarded -q
